summary: Allow idle resource lanes to replace their installed policy

schema.detail: No storage or client schema changes.

rules.detail: A request can atomically replace its host lane policy only when that lane has no queued, admitted, launched, retiring or uncertain memberships. The historical profile-less footprint upgrade remains allowed with live custody. Conflicts name the differing policy fields.

compatibility.detail: Idle lanes can change coverage, capacity, member limit or profile without clearing persisted rows manually. Live memberships retain their existing policy fence.

manual.detail: Redeclare an idle lane through the normal membership request.

recovery.detail: Existing policy formats remain readable on rollback.
